'''Master Jumper''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|Military rank]] in the [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]]. [[Barkin (Galactic Republic)|Barkin]] was one notable Rocket-Jumper that held the rank.
